Mojito

Time: time
Servings: 2l
Source: Sandyna
Tags: tested, sweet, drink, simple, vegetarian, gluten-free, milk-free

Ingredients

  • Mint leaves, 3-4 stalks worth
  • 100-200g Brown sugar, just eyeball it
  • 2-4 Limes
  • Water or sparkly water
  • Rum, if desired

Instructions

Wash the mint and remove about 10-15 leaves. Place in a blender with brown sugar, blend until it looks like wet sand.
Place the minty sugar, remaining mint leaves, lime juice and a few lime slices in a jug. Stir to reduce volume and to distribute ingredients evenly. Add water just to cover the ingredients.
Leave in the fridge overnight for extra flavour. Add more water and stir until the sugar dissolves. Strain, dilute to taste, add rum or ice as needed.
